rules.headings: font-serif (Playfair Display), tracking-tight, elegant. Do not use generic sans for headings.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing. p-6 or p-8 for cards.
spacing_and_layout.grid: Asymmetrical grids for marketing page. Control Room grid for dashboards.
spacing_and_layout.borders: Subtle 1px borders (border-white/10). No heavy drop shadows in dark mode, rely on borders and subtle gradients.

components.cards: Flat background (bg-card), 1px subtle border, rounded-lg. Hover: Slight lift and border color transition.
components.buttons: Primary buttons use cream (primary) with dark text. Clean edges or rounded-md.
components.status_badges: Shadcn Badge with custom outlined/soft variants from status_badges colors.
components.ride_cards: Clear hierarchy. Date/Time prominent. Route (pickup -> dropoff) uses an icon to connect. Status badge top right.

accessibility.data_testid: MANDATORY on all interactive and key informational elements (kebab-case, role-based).

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure dark mode is the default and only visible theme as per luxury archetype. Use the provided HSL values for the charcoal/slate and cream palette.
Implement the landing page with the hero image provided and an asymmetrical layout.
Dashboards should use 'Control Room' dense grid, with Shadcn components customized to match the colors.
Status badges must follow the exact color tokens provided in status_badges.
Ride cards should elegantly display Pickup, Dropoff, Date, Time, and Vehicle Type.
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, inputs, links, and key elements.
